regions: Ancient caldera rim and funerary plateau; legacy Marches inset preserved.
Ten existing dungeon doors remain in the legacy inset. New buffer roads teach salvage, fording and outpost return without moving a single entrance.
Re-open the four legacy shortcuts; learn seal/power grammar at the buffer waystation before leaving the quarter.
Glacial cirques, arêtes and a hanging valley draining south-west.
Snowline is an equipment test, not a level wall. The pass is visible from the Crown but the exposed ridge punishes unprepared travellers.
Thaw-season veins, ice-cave cores and a high observatory that only powers after a thermal ward.
Wave-cut terraces and silica cliffs; a short fast river falls to the east coast.
Lighthouses and wreck stairs reward coastal navigation. Storm glass forms where lightning meets silica sand.
Tide-gated wrecks and a storm-warded signal tower; revisit after cap_stormward.
Basalt flows, cinder cones and sulfur fumaroles east of the Crown escarpment.
Foundries and convict mines explain the industrial ruins. Heat and acid gas create preparation choices distinct from cold.
Fumarole cycles open obsidian seams; restore the old forge to refine higher cores.
Raised coral benches, a terminal salt pan and a wadi joining the Glasswind river.
Caravanserais and a tidal harbor make this the trade hinge. Water, not monsters, is the first logistics tax.
Caravan contracts, salt-pan harvesting after dry wind, and a harbor drydock for boats.
Folded limestone ridges and steep rainforest valleys; orographic rain feeds the south river.
deep ferralitic clay and leaf litter
Dense canopy hides terraced ruins. Poison and verticality reward filter gear and climbing, not raw damage.
Canopy temples, venom-core specimens and a root elevator opened by a living-wood puzzle.
Distributary channels, tidal flats and mangrove peat at the Glasswind mouth.
Stilt villages and drowned customs houses form a boat-dependent maze. Tide changes which channels are safe.
Abyssal pearls in tide-locked grottoes; a floating outpost earns its keep by shortening the return leg.
Old moraine hills south of the caldera; a gentle stream reaches the south coast.
brown forest earth and orchard terraces
The first genuinely new farming and timber belt. Abandoned orchards and a watermill give non-dungeon progression.
Mill repair unlocks a plank route; old stored fruit becomes valuable after a fermentation recipe.
A fault-dammed lake receives the Crown river and the Frostcrown tributary.
Fishers' piles, a drowned causeway and a lake observatory. The lake is a transport hub once a hull is built.
Drowned vault revealed by lowering a sluice; freshwater pearls and a ferry shortcut.
Tower karst, sinkholes and a submarine spring; surface water disappears underground.
Ruined orchard terraces collapse into cenotes. A visible sinkhole hints at the Ashwater resurgence long before it is usable.
Cenote diving after cap_deepward; a grafting puzzle revalues Amberwood cuttings.
Peat basin fed by the Mirrormere outlet and a karst resurgence; slow drainage to the south coast.
acid peat and toxic ash lenses
A poisoned wetland with stilt shrines and a buried pump station. Filter gear and boardwalks matter more than armour.
Pump restoration changes safe channels; a bog-core specimen and a late-game purification loop.
